title: Unequal daughters from a particle at rest
promptMarkdown: A hypothetical parent of mass $5m$ at rest decays into daughters of masses $m$ and $2m$. Derive the general two-body daughter-energy formula, then compute each energy, the common momentum magnitude, and each speed for these masses. Check energy conservation and both mass shells. Identify what additional physics would be needed to predict the direction or lifetime.
hintLadder: Use the parent rest frame when evaluating $P\cdot P_1$.
Find speeds from $pc^2/E$, not from Newtonian $p/m$.

criteria.criterion: The general formula and both energies are derived.
